notes: X watchlist pruned (status per account; 10 dormant). New YouTube account: @PeterHannamCarpentry. TikTok blocked by blank pages, no captcha. Window 9 Nov 07:25 UTC to 11 Nov ~07:25 UTC (UK time = UTC this week). About 15 public X read calls, all read-only, none failed. search_posts_all returned at most 25 posts per call even with max_results 100/500, so per-account medians came from get_users_posts timelines (20-25 originals each, replies and self-reply threads left out). Of the key accounts, only FixRadioUK posted trade content that beat its median in the window (its median is now 839, was 668 on 9 Nov). TradesTalk's last original (8 Nov 18:02) is outside the window, and next #TradesTalk is Tue 17 Nov. Screwfix's timeline has no original posts since 5 Aug 2024 (replies only). Checkatrade's last post was 21 Oct and skillbuilderuk's 27 Oct, so neither has hits. plumberparts is dormant (last 25 Dec 2024); the brief said 'plumbersparts', but the real handle is plumberparts. ToolstationUK is dormant (last 17 Sep 2025). GasSafeRegister's 10 Nov post had 203 views against a median of 350, so it's below median. RoofingToday's best was 89 views (1.46x its median of 61), so low absolute numbers. Keyword searches (site banter/sparky/plumber life/customer texts/just a quick job/tradesman/tradie/on the tools) were mostly US/Asian AI-receptionist SaaS spam, so I dropped them. 'Sparky' also matched a US cartoon fandom and an ASU mascot (dropped). 'rained off' matched an adult-content account (dropped). No organic UK tradesperson comedy post on X beat its median in the window, which confirms that UK trade comedy is thin on X.
